text: You're looking for a dish that's not only delicious but also packed with fiber to help you reach your health goal. I think the Mediterranean Mujadarra recipe is a great fit for you. It's a hearty and flavorful dish made with green lentils and basmati rice, which are both high in fiber. The addition of olive oil and spices gives it a rich and aromatic taste. Plus, it's quick to make and can be ready in under an hour, which fits within your time budget.
